plan.archetype: Efficient early damage into poison scaling and dexterity defense
plan.bossPrep: Establish poison and Footwork during sleep. Upgrade core powers, bring defensive potions and healthy HP; poison remains effective after strength siphons.
plan.summary: Take efficient damage early, then build poison and reliable defense. Add Accelerant after securing poison sources. Remove Strikes once damage improves; fight elites only with adequate health and potions.
